children: Medpacs are compact packages designed to both equip a trained medic for work in the field and allow untrained individuals to apply
in emergencies. A Medpac contains bandages, Bacta, synthetic flesh, coagulants, stimulants, and other medicines designed to help an injured patient recover quickly.
Once you use a Medpac, its contents are expended even if your
check is not successful. Any given creature can only benefit from the use of a Medpac once in a 24-hour period.
